calibrationSource: Software llvmpipe, Release, xcb, one CPU and 4 GiB in sketchyup-native-fonts-check:20261008 (R082gg-placement-limits.md). Not hardware evidence.
hardwareRequirement: Fresh Intel and AMD reruns per docs/M9_HARDWARE_SESSION.md section 1 are required before any ceiling below is accepted.
measurementPolicy: Fresh forward runs only; exact artifact/source/canonical fixture identities, separate Intel and AMD reports, actual framebuffer 1920x1080, unchanged five-cycle fixture, all ordinary timing/oracle requirements preserved. No retrospective pass is assigned.

excludedFrom1m.far: Far at 10,000 placements not yet measured. The earlier 'Inference probe intersects rendered geometry' failure from 1,200 placements was a fixture defect (the history loop detached the edited placement from its group), fixed in R082.hh; the product is unaffected.

classes.modeledWorstCaseControl: repeated 10,000 placements with SKETCHYUP_BENCHMARK_PLACEMENT_SHARING=0 (every placement draws its own world-space mesh)

calibration.modeledWorstCaseArithmetic: 288,276,480 base (1,000 shared placements) + 19,000 x 36,138 B per further placement (686.6 MB, larger than 40,000 bodies x 10.3 KB) + 600,000 x 2,542 B unshared viewport per materialized vertex (1,525.2 MB) + 100,000 x 917 B unique inference (91.7 MB) + 273,436,672 B maximum texture fixture = 2,865,235,152 B (2.67 GiB); core vertices are counted twice, so the bound is conservative.

sampledGrowthPolicy: Maximum current RSS minus first current RSS across 65 checkpoints after fixture warmup. Five identical edit/undo/redo cycles; no fixture or iteration reduction. This finite campaign cannot establish infinite-session boundedness.
driverPolicy: Unchanged from v1: require available=true, partial=false and a numeric residentUpperBoundBytes at warmup, final and every checkpoint on physical Intel/AMD. Never add DRM categories or their resident bound to process RSS.
rationale: R082.gg makes the 10,000-placement, million-triangle fixture public. With shared placement meshes (R082.dd), schema 26 storage (R082.cc), single-member inference (R082.ee) and incremental placement validation (R082.ff), its software peak RSS falls from the v1 experimental class to 614-884 MB, so it joins the supported class at 1.25 GiB, 52% above the largest measured family. The 100k ceiling stays at 1 GiB. The 3 GiB modeled ceiling bounds the worst-case document at the new limits on the unshared viewport path (for example an active section through every placement) and stays below the operational 4 GiB job cap. Ceilings come from software measurements; hardware RSS was about 150 MB higher at 1,000 placements in v1, and acceptance needs Intel/AMD reruns.
